# unifi_traffic_matching_list (List Resource)

List traffic matching lists in a site. Requires provider `api_key` authentication (the UniFi Network Integration API does not support username/password).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `site` (String) The site name or UUID to list traffic matching lists from.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the filter to apply. Supported values are: `name`, `type`.
- `value` (String) The value to filter by.
